candidate_reports.remark: Swift water rescue at West Craig Road and North Rancho Drive.
NV Energy site Enterprise Sierra Cliffs gusted to 60 mph in convective shower.
KLAS reports peak gust to 52 knots with convective showers.
Single gust of 58 mph measured at Five Mile RAWS sensor. FMRC1.
The Lee Canyon SNOTEL recorded 5 inches of new snow from 0300 PST on November 19th through 1700 PST on November 19th. This SNOTEL is at an elevation of 8626 feet.
The Rainbow Canyon SNOTEL recorded 8 inches of new snow from 0200 PST on November 19th through 1700 PST on November 19th. This SNOTEL is at an elevation of 7860 feet.
The Kyle Canyon SCAN Site recorded 3 inches of new snow from 0200 PST on November 19th through 1800 PST on November 19th. This site is at an elevation of 7010 feet.
Wind gusts in excess of 70 mph measured at the Angel Peak sensor occurred between 1850 and 1940. Peak gust was 77 mph at 1850. NV015.
The Bristlecone Trail SNOTEL recorded 7 inches of new snow from 2300 PST on November 18th through 1900 PST on November 19th. This SNOTEL is at an elevation of 8890 feet.
The Sawmill SNOTEL recorded 19 inches of new snow from 1500 PST on November 18th through 1900 PST on November 19th. This SNOTEL is at an elevation of 10200 feet.
The Cottonwood SNOTEL recorded 21 inches of new snow from 1400 PST on November 18th through 1900 PST on November 19th. This SNOTEL is at an elevation of 10150 feet.
The South Lake SNOTEL recorded 22 inches of new snow from 1300 PST on November 18th through 2100 PST on November 19th. This SNOTEL is at an elevation of 9600 feet.
The Rock Creek Lakes SNOTEL recorded 23 inches of new snow from 1500 PST on November 18th through 2100 PST on November 19th. This SNOTEL is at an elevation of 9700 feet.
